answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method for a suite of question & answering tasks that require sophisticated reasoning and domain knowledge... The generated answers cover the diagnosis, symptoms, recommended treatments, and medical tests.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to medical questions including disease diagnosis, test recommendations, drug recommendations, and explanations.

answer_2.quote: We used two metrics, BERTScore and GPT-4 Rating, for quantitative evaluation... In addition, we introduce a new metric for hallucination quantification... We evaluate all methods based on the accuracy of the generated choice.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 was employed to (1) rank answer quality against ground truth and (2) compare pairs of answers on four criteria...
